verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's first-party RAG docs say it retrieves relevant information from local and remote documents and incorporates it into chat responses, and it is positioned as replacing a separate document-search app. A community user also names RAG integrations as a key feature they depend on. Two users report RAG never worked for them in CPU-only / external-API-only setups; that is a configuration-specific limitation, not a general contradiction, so it lowers confidence rather than the verdict. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of persistent named knowledge-base collections, documented citation of document sources in answers, and reliable hands-on corroboration across deployment types (especially non-GPU).
